I'll load the Tokyo skill and search hotels for your dates.# Tokyo Food Trip — Draft Itinerary (10–13 Dec 2026)

**Overview**: Tokyo 3 nights, one base, no hotel changes | light · standard · standard · light
Solo, food-focused, 6000 CNY total. Hotel prices below are for 3 nights; the rest of the budget covers food, transport and incidentals — please check current rates before booking.

**Before you go**
- Get an IC card (Suica/PASMO) at the airport — covers JR, Metro, Toei and buses.
- Book any timed-entry or reservation-only places a few weeks ahead (popular sushi counters and small counters often need reservations; please check).
- December is cold but dry; pack layers. Many restaurants close one weekday — check before going.
- Decide your airport: Haneda is closer to the city (Keikyu to Shinagawa approx. 15–20 min); Narita is approx. 45 min to Ueno by Skyliner.

**Day 1 | Arrival · Shinjuku (light)**
- 14:00 Haneda Airport → Keikyu Line to Shinagawa, approx. 20 min, no transfer; then JR Yamanote to Shinjuku, approx. 20 min, no transfer (if Narita: Keisei Skyliner to Ueno then JR, approx. 70 min total, 1 transfer)
- 15:30 Check in at Shinjuku Washington Hotel Main, rest
- 17:30 Walk approx. 15 min to the west-side food alleys: Omoide Yokocho for yakitori — evening visit, lit up and atmospheric
- 19:30 Dinner in Golden Gai or a ramen shop near the station; early night
- Tonight: Shinjuku Washington Hotel Main (新宿华盛顿主酒店)

**Day 2 | Tsukiji · Ginza · Tokyo Station (standard)**
- 07:30 Shinjuku → Shinjuku Line to Tsukiji, approx. 20 min, no transfer — early morning is calmest at the outer market
- 08:00 Tsukiji Outer Market: tamagoyaki, grilled seafood, sushi breakfast
- 10:30 Walk approx. 15 min to Ginza; depachika food halls and a coffee stop
- 12:30 Lunch in Ginza (tempura or unagi)
- 14:30 Walk approx. 10 min to Tokyo Station / Marunouchi; character street and sweets shopping
- 17:00 Rest at the hotel or a café
- 19:00 Dinner in Ginza or Shimbashi izakaya; Ginza Line back to Shinjuku approx. 25 min, no transfer
- Alternatives: if rain, spend the afternoon in the Ginza depachika food halls and the Tokyo Station underground mall instead of walking Marunouchi; if tired, drop the Tokyo Station stop
- Tonight: Shinjuku Washington Hotel Main (新宿华盛顿主酒店)

**Day 3 | Shibuya · Harajuku · Shinjuku (standard)**
- 08:30 JR Yamanote to Harajuku, approx. 10 min, no transfer
- 09:00 Meiji Jingu — calmest early morning
- 10:30 Takeshita Street and Omotesando: crepes, sweets, coffee
- 12:30 Lunch in Harajuku or Omotesando
- 14:00 Walk approx. 15 min to Shibuya; Shibuya Sky or a rooftop café (timed entry — book ahead, please check)
- 17:00 Shibuya crossing at dusk, then depachika at Shibuya Station
- 19:00 Dinner in Shibuya (yakitori, sushi or a standing bar); JR Yamanote back to Shinjuku approx. 10 min
- Alternatives: if rain, swap Meiji Jingu for the Nezu Museum or a Shibuya department-store food hall; if tired, drop Shibuya Sky and keep the crossing at dusk
- Tonight: Shinjuku Washington Hotel Main (新宿华盛顿主酒店)

**Day 4 | Departure (light)**
- 08:30 Breakfast near the hotel; last-minute souvenirs at Shinjuku Station
- 10:30 Shinjuku → JR Yamanote to Shinagawa, approx. 20 min, no transfer; Keikyu to Haneda, approx. 20 min — leave plenty of time for check-in (if Narita: Narita Express from Shinjuku, approx. 80–90 min)

**Hotel notes**: Shinjuku Washington Hotel Main is the cheapest of the three at 918 CNY for the stay and puts you next to Shinjuku's food alleys. Mitsui Garden Hotel Shiodome Italia-gai (1191 CNY) is more central for Tsukiji and Ginza mornings; Mitsui Garden Hotel Gotanda (1124.67 CNY) is a quieter base near Shinagawa. All prices and availability should be re-checked before booking.

items.summary: Cheapest option, in Shinjuku — handy for Omoide Yokocho and Golden Gai food alleys.
